changes: The tall volcanoes in the Tall peak and Starter worlds look more like real mountains: the summit crater's rim is broken by notches, with rocky crags, and the highest point sits off-centre
Sharp ridges (cleavers) now run down the volcanoes' flanks up close, not only on the map
Glacier-carved bowls (cirques) under steep rock headwalls sit high on the flanks, with icy floors
